ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The basic tile in image1 is a 1×2 rectangle, composed of two adjacent small squares: on the left is a small green square with a star pattern, and on the right is a small purple square. In image2, from left to right there are 5 candidate patterns, all made from green star squares and purple squares. Reasoning: Each tile always covers two adjacent squares, and contains exactly 1 green star square and 1 purple square; the tile can be rotated, so green and purple can form one tile as long as they are adjacent up-down or left-right. Pattern 1: It has 5 green star squares and 5 purple squares, and the adjacent green-purple squares can be paired into 5 tiles, so it can be made. Pattern 2: When counting the colors, there are 8 green star squares and 6 purple squares. Because each tile must contribute 1 green and 1 purple, the color counts must be equal, so pattern 2 cannot be made. Pattern 3: It has 3 green star squares and 3 purple squares, and each green square can be paired with an adjacent purple square, so it can be made. Pattern 4: It has 5 green star squares and 5 purple squares, and can be divided into 5 pairs of adjacent green-purple squares, so it can be made. Pattern 5: It is a 3×3 frame, with one square missing in the middle, the four corners are green star squares, and the middles of the four sides are purple squares; along the frame, each green corner can be paired with an adjacent purple side square, so it can be made. Therefore, among the 5 patterns, only pattern 2 cannot be made, and a total of 4 can be made.

raw_record.question_text: Using these tiles, Robert makes different patterns. How many of the patterns shown below can he make?

method.method_draft: Inspect the picture first. Read image1 as a reusable 1-by-2 tile made of one green-star square joined to one purple square; since Robert makes patterns with the tile, allow the tile to be rotated, so every placed tile must cover two adjacent squares, one green and one purple. Read image2 as five candidate colored grid patterns from left to right. For each candidate, either find a complete pairing of adjacent green-purple squares or reject it by a necessary count test. Pattern 1 has 5 green and 5 purple squares and can be paired into five adjacent green-purple dominoes. Pattern 2 has unequal color counts: 8 green-star squares and 6 purple squares, so it cannot be made from tiles that always contribute one of each color. Pattern 3 can be paired vertically/horizontally into three adjacent green-purple dominoes. Pattern 4 has 5 green and 5 purple squares and can be paired into five adjacent green-purple dominoes. Pattern 5 is the 3-by-3 ring with the center missing, with 4 green corners and 4 purple edge-middle squares, and can be paired around the ring. Therefore exactly four of the five patterns can be made.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：image1 中的基本拼块是一个 1×2 的长方形，由两个相邻小正方形组成：左边是绿色带星形图案的小方格，右边是紫色小方格。image2 中从左到右有 5 个候选图案，都是由绿色星形方格和紫色方格拼成的。

推理：每块拼块总是覆盖两个相邻方格，并且恰好包含 1 个绿色星形方格和 1 个紫色方格；拼块可以旋转，所以绿色和紫色只要上下或左右相邻即可配成一块。

图案1：有 5 个绿色星形方格和 5 个紫色方格，并且可以把相邻的绿色-紫色方格配成 5 块拼块，所以可以做成。

图案2：数颜色时，有 8 个绿色星形方格和 6 个紫色方格。因为每块拼块必须贡献 1 绿和 1 紫，颜色数量必须相等，所以图案2不能做成。

图案3：有 3 个绿色星形方格和 3 个紫色方格，并且每个绿色方格都能与相邻的紫色方格配对，所以可以做成。

图案4：有 5 个绿色星形方格和 5 个紫色方格，并且可以分成 5 对相邻的绿色-紫色方格，所以可以做成。

图案5：是一个 3×3 方框，中间缺一格，四个角是绿色星形方格，四条边中间是紫色方格；可以沿着方框把每个绿色角和相邻紫色边格配对，所以可以做成。

因此 5 个图案中只有图案2不能做成，一共可以做成 4 个。
